messages:
emma-support: Customer reported intermittent 5xx on /v1/generate. They provided a request_id req_8c4a7b2f and two timestamps (2026-03-15 22:13 UTC and 22:27 UTC). Can ops pull server logs and help with repro steps?
ashwin-eng: Got it — forwarding to ops. Do we have the exact curl they used?
emma-support: They sent this minimal repro (redacted keys): ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'x-request-id: req_8c4a7b2f' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'```
noah-ops: I can search hot indices. Quick KQL I'll run: `request_id: "req_8c4a7b2f" and service: "invoker"` — note our hot retention for invoker is 30d, so it should be available.
samir-sre: If you think KV cache is involved add `and tags:kvcache` and also filter `@status` or `response_code`. Example KQL: ```request_id:"req_8c4a7b2f" and service:"invoker" and tags:kvcache | sort @timestamp desc```
ashwin-eng: Also ask customer to repro with `-H 'x-rw-trace: 1'` so we get trace IDs in future runs. If they can reproduce, request `-v` output.
emma-support: Requested trace header, customer replied it happened twice (22:13 and 22:27). They can't share full prod token but can run a curl with a temporary key.
noah-ops: Found invoker matches. Query I ran: ```kql
service:invoker and request_id:"req_8c4a7b2f" | sort @timestamp desc
```
noah-ops: Log excerpt: `2026-03-15T22:13:07Z invoker-23 request_id=req_8c4a7b2f status=502 upstream_error=timeout kv_cache_miss=true latency_ms=5120`
samir-sre: 502 + upstream_error=timeout + kv_cache_miss=true => origin backend timed out. Try adding `and upstream:edge-rt` to see which upstream returned the timeout.
noah-ops: Drilldown shows upstream=edge-rt-7a had a gap at 22:13:07. Could be transient. I can collect a diag bundle with surrounding logs: `diag-collector collect --request req_8c4a7b2f --before 60s --after 60s --output /tmp/req_8c4a7b2f.tgz`
ashwin-eng: I'll ping model infra to check container GC/oom around that timestamp and see if the model pod reported any stalls. Also confirm there's no billing throttle for this customer.
noah-ops: FYI retention note: hot logs kept 30d, archive after that to cold storage. If we needed older traces we'd have to run the archive fetch flow (longer latency).
emma-support: Customer asked for ETA and summary for their ticket. Can we produce a short write-up + diag link?
samir-sre: ETA ~20m to produce diag bundle + short blurb. Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: diag bundle created: https://s3.redwood-internal/diag/req_8c4a7b2f.tgz (expires 7 days)
emma-support: Passing the link and note to the customer now. Thanks all :pray:
